uncheckedChannels: Non-speech audio semantics: the source has an available audio stream, but the skill-run documents only a spectrogram/continuous-energy check. No listening-derived evidence establishes whether the bed contains music, effects, inserted-source audio, silence between speech, or any meaning-bearing audio change.

judgeFieldNotice: The five numeric values above are schema-required placeholders, not JUDGE scores. JUDGE was not run because uncheckedChannels and metaAudit failed.

unguardedCarriers: CAR-08 non-speech audio semantic content: existence was probed visually through a spectrogram, but the available audio itself was not independently evidenced as listened to or semantically inspected.
metaAudit.rationale: This meta result is independent of the candidate's self-declared coverageMatrix/metaGate. The candidate cites DS-03 only for continuous audio energy and expressly says the non-speech type cannot be determined. A spectrogram cannot substitute for listening to an available semantic audio carrier. The independent audit likewise records hasAudio/AAC but supplies no non-speech listening finding. Therefore one available carrier remains unguarded.

baselineComparison.rationale: No baseline-run artifact was present within the reviewer-authorized candidate scope, so no baseline comparison was inferred or fabricated.
